name: HubSpot
outlook:
What HubSpot says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: total revenueTotal revenue is expected to be in the range of $945.0 million to $947.0 million, up 12% year over year on an as-reported basis and in constant currency.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP operating incomeNon-GAAP operating income is expected to be in the range of $216.0 million to $217.0 million, representing a 23% operating income margin.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP net income per shareNon-GAAP net income per common share is expected to be in the range of $3.85 to $3.87. This assumes approximately 48.9 million weighted average diluted shares outstanding.
  • Full year 2026: total revenueTotal revenue is expected to be in the range of $3.685 billion to $3.687 billion, up 18% year over year on an as-reported basis and 16% in constant currency.
  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP net income per shareNon-GAAP net income per common share is expected to be in the range of $13.59 to $13.61. This assumes approximately 50.4 million weighted average diluted shares outstanding.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
